834.candidate_design: Iterative rooted traversal; postorder subtree sizes and downward sums; preorder reroot by n-2*subtree size.

842.candidate_design: Enumerate first two terms of at most10 digits each, then force every subsequent sum and match its decimal spelling.
842.complexity_target: O(100*L) time and O(L) output space

850.candidate_design: Sweep distinct x slabs; sort and merge active y intervals per slab; exact area product then modulo.
850.complexity_target: O(m^2 log m) time and O(m) space

857.candidate_design: Sort wage/quality ratios by cross multiplication; retain k smallest qualities in a max heap and evaluate current feasible ratio.
857.complexity_target: O(n log n+n log k) time and O(n+k) space
